explanation: Ecuador is simply Spanish for equator. The line also crosses Colombia and Brazil, and the highland city of Quito lies less than 30 km south of it.

claims.text: The name Ecuador is the Spanish word for the Equator.
Colombia, Brazil and Peru are not named after the Equator.
The Equator crosses Colombia and Brazil.
Quito lies less than 30 km south of the Equator.
